channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLbreakingNews, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Oregon school shooting leaves three children and teacher dead
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed and two others critically wounded at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. A suspect is in custody.

item.title: UK bookstores affected as Sally Rooney novels pulled over Palestine support
item.description: Sally Rooney's books are no longer sold in the U.K. after her support for Palestine Action, a group banned as a terrorist organization.

item.title: Former FBI agents sue over firings tied to Trump documents case
item.description: Nine former FBI agents who worked on President Trump's classified documents case have sued, alleging unlawful dismissal over their roles.

item.title: Alleged Chinese agent linked to scam network, records show
item.description: A California realtor charged as a Chinese agent and her partner have ties to people in sprawling criminal enterprises, according to records.
